Metric value.definition: Displays the formatted value for whichever axis is currently selected on the scatter plot, showing either the X-axis or Y-axis metric as a readable label. This measure ensures that tooltips and data callouts reflect the correct axis context when a user interacts with the chart. It supports a consistent and accurate data exploration experience by dynamically adapting the displayed value to the user's selection.

Formatted Y Tooltip.definition: Shows the value of the selected Y-axis metric in a clean, reader-friendly format when hovering over a data point on the scatter plot. The display automatically adjusts based on which metric is chosen — for example, showing member counts with comma separators, dollar signs for PMPM costs, or decimal places for risk scores. This ensures tooltip values are easy to read and consistently presented regardless of which metric is being analyzed.

Y Axis Title.definition: Displays the name of the metric currently selected by the user for the vertical axis of the scatter plot. It updates automatically based on the user's slicer choice, ensuring the chart axis is clearly labeled at all times. If no selection has been made, it defaults to the prompt "Select Y Metric" to guide the user.

Selected Y Axis Value.definition: Displays the current value for whichever measure the user has selected for the vertical axis of the scatter plot. As the user switches between options such as Members, PMPM, or RAF Recapture Rate, this metric automatically updates to reflect the corresponding figure for each data point. This ensures the chart always shows accurate, context-appropriate values aligned with the user's chosen analysis focus.
